Below are reliable **online beauty retailers that ship to Kuwait**, compared on what tends to matter most: **availability + speed + fees/duties + product restrictions**. (Shipping terms can vary by basket and brand; fragrance/aerosols are the most commonly restricted category.)

## Quick comparison (ships to Kuwait)

| Retailer | Best for | Delivery to Kuwait (what’s known) | Duties/taxes | Common gotchas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Sephora Middle East (sephora.me/kw)** | Big-name prestige brands with Kuwait-focused service | Has a Kuwait site and Kuwait delivery FAQ. ([sephora.me](https://www.sephora.me/kw-en?scgid=C303&utm_source=openai)) | Typically handled as a regional e-comm order (less “surprise customs” vs cross-border), but check at checkout | Some items may be “online only” / stock varies vs US/EU Sephora |
| **Cult Beauty** | UK/EU “cult” skincare + trending brands | Lists **Kuwait** in international delivery; deliveries **Mon–Fri via DHL**. ([cultbeauty.com](https://www.cultbeauty.com/c/info/delivery-information/international-delivery/?utm_source=openai)) | May require you to pay **local taxes/customs on arrival**. ([cultbeauty.com](https://www.cultbeauty.com/c/info/delivery-information/international-delivery/?utm_source=openai)) | Duties can be the main downside; some hazmat/fragrance limits |
| **LOOKFANTASTIC (Middle East / UAE site)** | Lots of brands + frequent promos; often good value | Has dedicated Middle East delivery info including **Kuwait** (with local-region options). ([lookfantastic.ae](https://www.lookfantastic.ae/c/info/delivery-information/?utm_source=openai)) | Notes that charges like duties/taxes **aren’t included** in the invoice. ([lookfantastic.ae](https://www.lookfantastic.ae/c/info/delivery-information/?utm_source=openai)) | Multiple warehouses/stock rules; “UAE-shipped” vs other stock can change delivery options |
| **Selfridges** | Luxury + hard-to-find UK/EU beauty | International delivery to many regions; restrictions shown on PDP/checkout. Kuwait is included in Selfridges+ destinations (minimum order rules apply). ([selfridges.com](https://www.selfridges.com/GB/en/info/dispatch-delivery/international-delivery/?utm_source=openai)) | Depends on destination/checkout; expect possible import fees | Brand- and product-level shipping restrictions (fragrance/aerosols are common) |
| **Harrods** | Luxury beauty + gifts/sets | International delivery is available, but **some Beauty/Grooming items can’t ship internationally** (they flag limits). ([harrods.com](https://www.harrods.com/en-sa/c/faqs/delivery?utm_source=openai)) | Varies by checkout/destination | Beauty category exclusions can be significant for certain items |

## How to choose (fast rules)
- **Want simplest Kuwait delivery + local returns/support:** start with **Sephora Middle East (Kuwait site)**. ([sephora.me](https://www.sephora.me/kw-en?scgid=C303&utm_source=openai))  
- **Want widest “trending skincare” selection:** **Cult Beauty** (but budget for potential customs). ([cultbeauty.com](https://www.cultbeauty.com/c/info/delivery-information/international-delivery/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Want deals and broad catalog:** **LOOKFANTASTIC (ME)** (watch whether duties are included—often not). ([lookfantastic.ae](https://www.lookfantastic.ae/c/info/delivery-information/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Want luxury/UK exclusives:** **Selfridges** or **Harrods**, but expect more **item-level shipping restrictions**. ([selfridges.com](https://www.selfridges.com/GB/en/info/dispatch-delivery/international-delivery/?utm_source=openai))  

## A few practical tips for Kuwait deliveries
- **Check “fragrance / aerosols / nail polish” early**: these are frequently restricted in cross-border shipping (you’ll see it at product page/checkout on stores like Selfridges/Harrods). ([selfridges.com](https://www.selfridges.com/GB/en/info/dispatch-delivery/international-delivery/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Prefer DHL/express for fewer issues**: Cult Beauty explicitly indicates DHL for Kuwait. ([cultbeauty.com](https://www.cultbeauty.com/c/info/delivery-information/international-delivery/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Duties clarity:** if the site says duties/taxes may be due on arrival (Cult Beauty) or not included in invoice (LOOKFANTASTIC), assume you’ll pay something unless the checkout explicitly says “duties paid”. ([cultbeauty.com](https://www.cultbeauty.com/c/info/delivery-information/international-delivery/?utm_source=openai))  

If you tell me (1) what you’re mainly buying (**skincare vs makeup vs fragrance**), (2) your **budget range**, and (3) whether you care more about **lowest total cost vs fastest delivery**, I can narrow this to the best 2–3 options and what to watch for at checkout.
